issue_context.title: Move test specific functions from e2e core framework
issue_context.body:
**What happened**:

During the work for reducing invalid dependencies from the e2e core framework to subpackages of the core framework, we found a lot of particular test specific functions.
That means these each function is used at a single e2e test module only.
These functions are unnecessary to be shared as e2e framework function, so we've just
moved these functions to the particular test module like https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/84261
This cleanup work will help us to maintain the e2e core framework in long term, so it is
helpful to share this work in volunteers as a community.

This issue is for tracking this working items.

**How to do that?**:
1. Each volunteer selects a single file which is empty (no PR, no assignee) from the following e2e core framework
2. List all functions in the file
3. Check all callers of each function
4. If finding the function is called at a single e2e test package only, let's move the function to the module with a PR

**Implementation rules**:
- If a function is called from 2+ test packages, don't move the function from the core package.
- If moving of the function requires invalid code dependencies, don't move the function.
(Dependency from e2e core framework to other `k8s.io/kubernetes` repository)

**List of files of e2e core framework**:

- [x] cleanup.go (@hwdef )
- [x] create.go (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/84463)
- [x] exec_util.go (@SataQiu)
- [x] expect.go (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/84410)
- [x] flake_reporting_util.go
- [x] framework.go (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/84411)
- [x] get-kubemark-resource-usage.go
- [x] google_compute.go (@clarklee92 )
- [x] log.go (Done)
- [x] log_size_monitoring.go (@clarklee92 )
- [x] nodes_util.go (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/84412)
- [x] pods.go (@YuikoTakada )
- [x] profile_gatherer.go (@hwdef )
- [x] provider.go (@hwdef )
- [x] rc_util.go (@SataQiu https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/84495)
- [x] resource_usage_gatherer.go (@clarklee92 )
- [x] size.go (@tanjunchen )
- [x] skip.go (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/84881)
- [x] suites.go (@YuikoTakada https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/84499)
- [x] test_context.go (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/84875)
- [x] util.go (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/85149)

**References**:

* This working item was under discussion as https://kubernetes.slack.com/archives/C9NK9KFFW/p1572027916008400
